# cato_roles (Data Source)

Reads all matching custom and predefined IAM roles, automatically fetching every API page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example usage:
#   export TF_VAR_token="your-api-token"
#   export TF_VAR_account_id="123456"
#   terraform init
#   terraform plan

terraform {
  required_providers {
    cato = {
      source = "catonetworks/cato"
    }
  }
}

variable "token" {
  description = "Cato API token (set with TF_VAR_token)."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

variable "account_id" {
  description = "Cato account ID (set with TF_VAR_account_id)."
  type        = string
}

variable "baseurl" {
  description = "Cato GraphQL API endpoint."
  type        = string
  default     = "https://api.catonetworks.com/api/v1/graphql2"
}

provider "cato" {
  baseurl    = var.baseurl
  token      = var.token
  account_id = var.account_id
  #retry_max              = 3
  #retry_wait_min_seconds = 10
  #retry_wait_max_seconds = 30
}

data "cato_roles" "example" {
  # account_id     = var.account_id
  # sort_direction = "ASC"
  # filter = {
  #   id = {
  #     eq  = "98765"
  #     neq = "98766"
  #     in  = ["98765", "98767"]
  #     nin = ["98766"]
  #   }
  #   name = {
  #     eq  = "Read-only sites"
  #     neq = "Editor"
  #     in  = ["Read-only sites", "Viewer"]
  #     nin = ["Editor"]
  #   }
  #   predefined = {
  #     eq  = false
  #     neq = true
  #   }
  # }
}

output "roles" {
  value = data.cato_roles.example.items
}

output "total" {
  value = data.cato_roles.example.total
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Account ID. Defaults to the provider account_id.
- `filter` (Attributes) Optional role filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `sort_direction` (String) Sort roles by name in ASC or DESC order. Defaults to ASC.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Account identifier for this lookup.
- `items` (Attributes List) All matching roles in API sort order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `total` (Number) Number of matching roles.

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Optional:

- `id` (Attributes) Filter operators, combined using the API's filtering semantics. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--id))
- `name` (Attributes) Filter operators, combined using the API's filtering semantics. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--name))
- `predefined` (Attributes) Filter predefined or custom roles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--predefined))

<a id="nestedatt--filter--id"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter.id`

Optional:

- `eq` (String) Equal to this value.
- `in` (Set of String) Match any of these values.
- `neq` (String) Not equal to this value.
- `nin` (Set of String) Exclude these values.


<a id="nestedatt--filter--name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter.name`

Optional:

- `eq` (String) Equal to this value.
- `in` (Set of String) Match any of these values.
- `neq` (String) Not equal to this value.
- `nin` (Set of String) Exclude these values.


<a id="nestedatt--filter--predefined"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter.predefined`

Optional:

- `eq` (Boolean) Equal to this predefined status.
- `neq` (Boolean) Exclude this predefined status.



<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `account_id` (String) Account used for this lookup.
- `account_type` (String) Account type applicable to the role.
- `description` (String) Role description; an absent description is represented as an empty string.
- `id` (String) Account-scoped Terraform identifier, ACCOUNT_ID:ROLE_ID.
- `is_used_on_external_access` (Boolean) Whether external access currently uses the role.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Permissions granted by the role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--permissions))
- `predefined` (Boolean) Whether this role is predefined and immutable.
- `role_id` (String) Stable API role identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--items--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.permissions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Granted RBAC action.
- `resource` (String) Permission resource identifier.
